message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic, modern, and cult‑favorite horror films you might enjoy:

| Year | Title | Why it’s worth watching |
|------|-------|------------------------|
| 1960 | **Psycho** (Alfred Hitchcock) | A masterclass in suspense and psychological terror. |
| 1968 | **Night of the Living Dead** (George A. Romero) | The original zombie film that changed the genre. |
| 1974 | **The Texas Chain Saw Massacre** (Tobe Hooper) | Raw, gritty horror that still feels visceral. |
| 1980 | **The Shining** (Stanley Kubrick) | A chilling psychological thriller with iconic imagery. |
| 1984 | **A Nightmare on Elm Street** (Wes Craven) | Introduces Freddy Krueger, blending dream logic with gore. |
| 1991 | **The Silence of the Lambs** (Jonathan Demme) | A tense thriller with unforgettable characters. |
| 1999 | **The Blair Witch Project** (Daniel Myrick & Eduardo Sánchez) | Pioneered the found‑footage style. |
| 2002 | **28 Days Later** (Danny Boyle) | A fast‑paced, post‑apocalyptic zombie film. |
| 2004 | **Saw** (James Wan) | Dark, twisted puzzles that keep you guessing. |
| 2007 | **Paranormal Activity** (Oren Peli) | Low‑budget found‑footage that still terrifies. |
| 2010 | **The Conjuring** (James Wan) | A modern classic of haunted‑house horror. |
| 2012 | **The Cabin in the Woods** (Dennis Dugan) | A meta‑take on horror tropes. |
| 2014 | **It Follows** (David Robert Mitchell) | A fresh take on the “invisible threat” concept. |
| 2015 | **The Witch** (Robert Eggers) | A slow‑burning, atmospheric period horror. |
| 2017 | **Get Out** (Jordan Peele) | A socially conscious horror with sharp satire. |
| 2018 | **A Quiet Place** (John Krasinski) | Silence is the ultimate weapon. |
| 2019 | **Midsommar** (Ari Aster) | Daylight horror that’s as unsettling as it is beautiful. |
| 2020 | **The Invisible Man** (Leigh Whannell) | A modern retelling with strong feminist themes. |
| 2021 | **Candyman** (Nia DaCosta) | A fresh, culturally rich take on a horror legend. |
| 2022 | **The Black Phone** (Scott Derrickson) | A supernatural thriller with a unique premise. |
| 2023 | **M3GAN** (Zack Snyder) | A creepy, tech‑savvy horror about a doll. |

Feel free to pick based on your preferred sub‑genre—psychological, supernatural, slasher, or something else!
